name: Backend/API
purpose: Backend services, APIs, workers, distributed systems and integrations. Adds domain modelling, interface contracts, data architecture, resilience and day-to-day operations.
use_when: The project owns server-side logic or data that other software depends on: its own clients, other teams or outside partners.
Failures, retries, concurrency or data consistency need deliberate design.
The team deploys, monitors and keeps services running.
not_when: The backend is a hosted service used as-is (a CMS, a database service, a form handler) with no logic of your own. Describe it in SYSTEM_DESIGN.md.
A handful of serverless functions only forward requests. Describe them in the other profile's architecture document.
A server framework is in use. Technology alone never activates a profile.

documents.when: An API or event stream has several consumers, outside teams or versioning needs.
The system has more than one data store, migrates live data, or must meet backup, retention or residency rules.

checks.name: Integration tests
checks.what: Services run against their real dependencies (database, queues) or faithful stand-ins.

checks.name: API compatibility
checks.what: Changes to public interfaces are checked for breaking changes before release.
